{{Quote|Tangrene was our real crowning achievement. We blasted a major Ubiqtorate center into fine powder. And then waltzed out right under the collective nose of the three Star Destroyers that were supposed to be guarding the place.|[[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]]|<ref name="DFR" />}}
A '''raid''' on [[Tangrene]] took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and was [[Garm Bel Iblis's movement]]'s most prestigious military victory.<ref name="DFRSb" />

[[Tangrene]] was the location of an Imperial [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]] center attacked by [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] with all his five [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]], three years after his split from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Bel Iblis' forces managed to lure three [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] guarding the place and destroyed the Ubiqtorate base. The Rebel casualties were relatively light with moderate damage and one [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] out of commission for nearly seven months.<ref name="DFR" />
